title: Unit Event — The Power of Regret — Episode2 Morinomiya Music Academy

meta.Event Outline: Nene and her friends have made it to their final training destination, the Morinomiya Revue. While Nene goes into the experience excited to further grow as an actress, the boys' separate training and Emu's focus on business studies leave her attending practices on her own...

rows.Line: Morinomiya Music Academy - Rehearsal Room

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Good morning, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Whoa...
They're all bowing at the same exact angle.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This feels more like a professional sports team than a musical troupe. I guess they do have it pretty hard here...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And I have to do my best to keep up with them.)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
This is Nene Kusanagi.
She will be studying at Morinomiya with all of you for the next three months.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: She still has to attend her regular school like normal, so she won't be here all day during the week. But she will be here from start to finish otherwise.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: If you don't mind introducing yourself.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Of course...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
My name is Nene Kusanagi!
I'm a member of a troupe called Wonderlands×Showtime, and will be studying to improve my acting skills here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to working with all of you starting today!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: We look forward to working with you as well!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Studying here means that you'll be treated the same as any other Morinomiya student, Ms. Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: So, everyone, if she has any questions regarding the rules and expectations we place on our students, please help her out.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Anyway, that concludes our morning meeting. Let's do our best again today to uphold the name of Morinomiya.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Phew...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That was a little nerve-wracking, but I'm glad I was able to introduce myself to everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But I have to stay focused.
I need to do my best in order to learn new acting techniques and other ways to express myself using my body...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's see... I'm starting with a ballet lesson. The classroom for it should be...
se_walk_women_005_3
se_walk_women_005_2
Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-Yes?!
Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: My name's Imura! I'm really looking forward to working with you! Things might be a little hard at first since the rules here are so strict, but feel free to ask me any questions!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, thank you...

rows.Speaker: Mori
rows.Line: Nice to meet you. I'm Mori.

rows.Speaker: Mori
rows.Line: Come to think of it, have you already received today's schedule? You're going to need it, so I can have a copy made if you don't have one.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, I just received a copy a minute ago.
But thank you for offering.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The people in this class are a lot nicer than I was expecting...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I hesitated for a second there, since this place is so famous for being strict. But I guess my worries were misplaced.)
Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yes, how can I...?
...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Whoa...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This person has perfect posture.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Her core seems incredibly strong.
It's like she's ready to perform at a moment's notice.)
Forgive me for doing this just before our lesson, but I felt that I should introduce myself to our new addition.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
My name is Byakkomachi.
I'm the head of this class.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
The head...?
Like a class president?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Yes, that's essentially my job.

rows.Speaker: Mori
rows.Line: As the head of our class, Byakkomachi sits at the top of the pyramid.

rows.Speaker: Mori
rows.Line: Many who enroll in this school are already talented singers and dancers in their own right.

rows.Speaker: Mori
rows.Line: But Byakkomachi here stands head and shoulders above the rest of us. The executives and staff can't seem to get enough of her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I had no idea...!
Umm... I feel honored to be speaking with somebody in your position.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Haha. You're going to make me blush.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: In any case, as the head of this class and your fellow classmate, I plan on giving you all the support I can.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I'll show you around the changing and recreations rooms once our lesson is finished.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you.
I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: There's no need to thank me. It's all a part of the job. Oh, look at the time. Our lesson is about to start...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Right!
Um, how should I start preparing or warming up?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: First, let's use the mirror... Oh, before that.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: There's something I need to tell you, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: You're not officially enrolled here and you're only here for a limited time, but you will be treated the same as the rest of us.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Simultaneously, you'll be expected to act and produce results all on your own.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
Things aren't going to be easy.
But I hope that you'll still do your best.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yes!
I understand!

rows.Speaker: Ballet Teacher
rows.Line: When you perform a grand jeté, maintain control all the way down to your fingertips! You will not be able to dance with grace unless you have control over every part of your body!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Understood!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Even after all that training we did with Mikazukigumi...
My legs feel like jelly already just from ballet basics...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But the others haven't stopped dancing for a second... Just how much stamina do they have...?!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Still, I can't let them leave me behind.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have to keep going, no matter how hard any lesson gets!)

rows.Speaker: Ballet Teacher
rows.Line:
That should be enough for today.
This lesson is adjourned.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huff...! Huff...! Huff...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I can finally catch my breath...)

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line:
That was incredible, Kusanagi!
It's only your first day, but you managed to keep up!

rows.Speaker: Mori
rows.Line:
I agree!
I remember being completely exhausted during my first day.

rows.Speaker: Mori
rows.Line: Please try to stay hydrated, since these practices are likely going to feel extra difficult while you try to get used to things around here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you! I'll be careful!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
Excuse me, ma'am.
Do you have a little time right now?

rows.Speaker: Ballet Teacher
rows.Line: How can I help you, Ms. Byakkomachi?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Could I ask you to look over how I dance from the middle through the finale? I still feel like I'm missing something...

rows.Speaker: Ballet Teacher
rows.Line:
But your form is near perfect.
It seems unnecessary to push yourself any harder...

rows.Speaker: Ballet Teacher
rows.Line:
Alright, fine...
Show me. But only just this once.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Thank you!
se_event_regret_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She's so elegant...

rows.Speaker: Mori
rows.Line:
She really is...
Even after that lesson, she doesn't look tired at all.

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: I know, right? I guess this is what it means to possess world-class talent.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: World-class?

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: Yeah, she's so good that world-famous directors have been coming to visit our school in addition to seeing our shows. For example, Jack Howard, the creator of “Spirit”...

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: And he isn't alone. All sorts of people have been trying to recruit her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, really...?!

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line:
Yes, really!
You won't believe how many people have already asked her to audition for their troupes and companies!

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: But despite all that, she chose to enroll at Morinomiya! Because she loves this place so much!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's clear that she has the talent to become a world-class performer. That's obvious just based on her aura and how refined her movements are...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If I'm going to do the same, I have to become as good as her at the very least.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'll have to do my best during our next lesson...!

rows.Speaker: Voice Teacher
rows.Line: Next, I'd like for you all to sing one at a time. We'll start with the front row at this end.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Understood!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Now we're having a singing lesson.
Everyone's good...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But this is my chance to do well...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This is my wheelhouse, so I need to show everyone what I've got!)

rows.Speaker: Voice Teacher
rows.Line: Alright, next.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Her voice is so beautiful...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you. That's it from me...

rows.Speaker: Voice Teacher
rows.Line:
Oh, pardon me. Thank you.
Please take a seat.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She hesitated there for a second. Does that mean I didn't do well? I thought I did okay...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (No, I don't have time for that right now. I need to stay focused on this lesson.)

rows.Speaker: Voice Teacher
rows.Line:
Okay, that concludes today's lesson.
You'd like to tell them about it now, yes?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Yes, so...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: As I'm sure you all already know, auditions for our next quarterly performance will be held soon.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Quarterly performance? Auditions?
This is news to me...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Also, what happened...?
Why do things feel so tense now all of a sudden?)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: The title of this performance will be announced tomorrow during your acting lesson. Please let us know if you know that you will not be present.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Also, Ms. Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: We will be expecting you to audition for this performance.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?
